en.headline: Ankôma opens Causeway Bay dining room after leaving TST
en.dek: Chef Frankie Wong’s French-Japanese restaurant has moved to Cubus on Hoi Ping Road, with a mid-September tasting menu and seats from 6:30pm.
body: French-Japanese restaurant Ankôma has left its Tsim Sha Tsui chef’s table and opened a new dining room on the 16th floor of Cubus, 1 Hoi Ping Road, Causeway Bay. The restaurant said the new space has a larger open kitchen, a 24-seat dining room and a private room after three years in Kowloon.

Chef Frankie Wong, who received the Michelin Guide Hong Kong and Macau Young Chef Award in 2025, said a new tasting menu would be served from mid-September. The restaurant’s public listing puts dinner service daily from 6:30pm to 11:00pm, with last seating at 8:30pm. Reservations are taken by telephone on 2981 1688.

Ankôma was named a Michelin Selected restaurant in 2025 and 2026. The operators said the Causeway Bay kitchen includes more room for dry-ageing and pastry work. The move comes as several mid-sized independent dining rooms have shifted from Tsim Sha Tsui hotel and mall floors into smaller commercial towers on Hong Kong Island.

zh.headline: Ankôma遷入銅鑼灣CUBUS 中九月推新嚐味餐單
zh.dek: 主廚黃師傅的法日餐廳結束尖沙嘴主廚餐桌後，新址設於開平道1號CUBUS 16樓，晚上6時半起供應晚餐。
body: 法日餐廳Ankôma已結束在尖沙嘴三年的主廚餐桌，遷至銅鑼灣開平道1號CUBUS 16樓。餐廳表示新址設有較大的開放式廚房、24個座位的用餐區及一間包廂。
主廚黃師傅曾獲2025年《香港澳門米芝蓮指南》年輕主廚大獎，餐廳稱中九月起供應全新嚐味餐單。公開資料顯示，服務時間為每日下午6時半至11時，最後入座時間為晚上8時半，訂座電話2981 1688。
Ankôma於2025年及2026年同獲米芝蓮指南「入選餐廳」評級。經營者指新廚房預留更多空間處理乾式熟成及甜品。近年有獨立餐廳由尖沙嘴商場及酒店樓層，遷往港島較小型商廈。
